12.source_text: Solomon, the son of David, was endowed with wisdom above the sons of men, and chosen of the Lord to rear Him a Temple, the like of which the world has not seen before or since ; and was otherwise blessed and prospered above all the kings of Israel. This man was likewise a polygamist whilst the Lord favoured him so remarkably.
